# interfere_tracking_domain (Resource)

Manage a workspace tracking hostname. Creation returns while DNS and TLS verification is pending. Configure a DNS-only CNAME to cname_target using your DNS provider. Import with workspace-slug/domain-UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "interfere_tracking_domain" "telemetry" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
  name           = "telemetry.example.com"
}
output "tracking_cname_target" {
  value = interfere_tracking_domain.telemetry.cname_target
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Lowercase fully qualified tracking hostname, without a trailing dot.
- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Optional

- `idempotency_key` (String) Creation UUID, generated automatically when omitted. Explicit UUIDs remain supported for recovering an uncertain creation. Reuse that UUID to retry; use a fresh UUID for replacement.

### Read-Only

- `cname_target` (String) DNS-only CNAME target for the tracking hostname.
- `id` (String) Unique tracking domain identifier.
- `ssl_status` (String) Current TLS certificate provisioning status.
- `status` (String) Current hostname verification status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import interfere_tracking_domain.telemetry example/574e2f70-dc84-4ce0-8db7-f5ecf2acdc82
```
